content: Certification and credential expiration tracking is commonly a SEPARATE product category, e.g. Expiration Reminder, Remindax, TalentGuard, RenewOps, from core scheduling software; these tools send email, SMS or WhatsApp alerts before a license or cert lapses and centralize renewal deadlines. This is evidence that expiration-aware qualification blocking is not universally built into scheduling engines; many organizations bolt on a separate compliance tool rather than getting it from their scheduler, itself a gap worth flagging.
